privacy.html.replace:
Link and QR-code previews

When you are signed in, a link you check in the app, including one in a QR code, can come with a picture of the page, but only if you tap Show a picture of this page. CyberNet AI then sends that web address, and nothing else, to GetScreenshot, a service of Rasterwise, and, if it is slow or unavailable, to Microlink. Their computers open the page and send back a screenshot, so the page never runs on your iPhone. They receive the full web address, including anything written inside it, but not your name, email address or account details. CyberNet AI shows the picture in the result and does not store it on its servers; the providers may keep the address and the picture for a short time under their own terms. If a link carries private details, such as a password-reset or invitation link, those details reach the preview service too.
privacy.html.why: Owner, 11 Nov 2026: the app shows a picture of a page on request (signed-in accounts); this section describes the app's version
